comment: macpro71: a desktop PC (MSI B460M PRO MS-7C88, Core i5-10400 Comet Lake-S, Radeon RX 580 Polaris, Intel AX210 Wi-Fi, Realtek 8168 Ethernet, Realtek ALC892) started as a MacPro7,1: the SMBIOS the macpro71 pack's OpenCore configuration gives it. Tahoe supports MacPro7,1 natively, so its donors and OCLP's base config fit; the machine has no Apple firmware and no T2.

efi_build.comment: Same ESP base as generic: the qemu_reference_efi row (OpenCore on OVMF: EFI/BOOT/BOOTx64.efi, the path non-Apple firmware starts) with the pinned OpenCore release's binaries; the PC's UEFI starts that path, there is no Apple firmware.

cpu.why: The real CPU of the test machine: Intel Core i5-10400 (Comet Lake-S, 6 cores): the Ivy Bridge baseline plus AVX2, FMA, BMI1/2, MOVBE and the other Haswell-and-newer instructions. AVX2 is why the pack's boot-args carry -crypt_force_avx.
